definitions.explanation: Fish cooked by simmering in a broth typically made with soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar. A staple of traditional Japanese home cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煮魚|にざかな}だ。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{煮魚|にざかな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧おいしい。
examples.english: My mother's simmered fish is the best.

examples.japanese: {定食屋|ていしょくや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{煮魚|にざかな}⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}したら→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧、{金目鯛|きんめだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I ordered the simmered fish set meal at the restaurant, they served simmered golden-eye snapper.

notes:
USAGE:
A classic component of Japanese home cooking (⟦{家庭料理|かていりょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧). Common fish used for {煮魚|にざかな} include ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧ (mackerel), {鰈|かれい} (flounder), and {金目鯛|きんめだい} (golden-eye snapper). The cooking method is called ⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煮魚|にざかな}⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧ (simmered fish set meal)
- {煮魚|にざかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make simmered fish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧: grilled fish — another staple of Japanese cuisine
- ⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧: simmered dish — the cooking method itself, can apply to fish or vegetables
